purpose: Retain completed v4 publication receipt independently of next-development and preserve immutable binary publication assets.

replacements.before:
uses: ./.buildchain/runtime/actions/v4-release-candidate-promote
        with: *provider-inputs

      - name: Retain canonical APPLY and ReleaseReceipt evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1

controller-receipt-status: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.status || steps.projection-state.outputs.status }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the admitted receipt verifier
        if: ${{ needs.apply.result == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0
        with:
          repository: kungfu-systems/buildchain
replacements.after:
controller-receipt-status: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.status || steps.projection-state.outputs.status }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the admitted receipt verifier
        if: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.action == 'promote' && !inputs.dry-run }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0
        with:
          repository: kungfu-systems/buildchain
